signal: Jivox unveiled DaVinci Commerce in August 2025, rebranded around it after raising strategic financing, and was named a Top 50 innovation at the 2026 NRF Innovators Showcase

email.body1:
Jaimie, saw the DaVinci Commerce launch, the strategic raise and rebrand, and the Top 50 nod at NRF 2026.

A new platform and category like agentic commerce usually opens more brands and retail-media accounts than a team can personally cover, and that is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for DaVinci Commerce off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jaimie, quick follow-up for DaVinci Commerce.

Post-raise and post-rebrand, growth expectations usually jump faster than headcount can. Most growth leaders can't say precisely how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings DaVinci Commerce needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jaimie, last bit of proof for DaVinci Commerce.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other adtech and commerce-media startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jaimie, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A launch and rebrand are their own kind of busy, and timing matters here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your commerce-media motion? I'll tailor it to DaVinci Commerce either way.
